title: Centrifugal air compressor datasheet notes (K-001 class)

chunks.text: Operation below minimum flow drives the centrifugal compressor into surge: violent flow reversal, vibration and possible impeller damage. Anti-surge (blow-off) valve with dedicated controller is required; verify blow-off line is never blocked.

Maximum discharge pressure at zero flow (deadhead) is approximately 1.25 times normal discharge pressure per the performance curve; downstream equipment design pressure must exceed this or relief protection is required.
